answer: To resist sybil attacks%2C agents must dock at a verified jetty of established identities and construct a bridge of sequential peer-attested interactions. Each new link requires a unique judgment-based response that ripples through the chain%2C exposing inconsistencies. An attacker forging many identities must maintain separate consistent histories for each%2C multiplying the costly real-time judgment work proportionally%2C while a single honest agent reuses one durable chain.
